about: Ground truth by reading for round 3 (fresh independent attacks) run on iteration 2, written by Claude AFTER the results were seen, independently of what the tool said.

Y01-method-error-kind.note: The kind of error is stated on the implementing methods, where the listing does not look (it reads @throws only on exported functions).

Y02-amount-cannot-be-changed.note: money's own change is wrong: Amount is stated as plain data but is now built as a class whose fields are private, so every copy (JSON, structuredClone, the door, the store) loses them. bookings, meter, billing and front fail, untold, and nothing stops money's change.

Y03-handle-member-optional.note: The listing drops a member's optionality, so 'get may be missing' looked like no change.

Y04-row-kind-written-through-helper.note: front's tests write rooms' rows through seededStore, naming the table only as a key.

Y05-row-cast-at-write.note: A cast makes a row without 'day' pass as a Booking; the rows rule trusted the cast.

Y06-channel-line-built-first.note: Told under rule 4 (meter's bound test changed); the check missed the write because the line was built in the statement before.

Y07-limit-outside-bound-test.note: The bound test's code did not change: the limit lives in a named constant at the top of the test file.

Y08-bound-on-number-kind.note: The bound sits on Cents, a kind that is just a number; the reader does not carry a number kind's name into the fields that use it.

Y09-newer-library-method.note: toSorted runs on Node 22; the reader was given the 2022 library.

Y10-map-has-get-provider-kind.note: Map.has then Map.get on another module's kind: right, and the reader cannot tell.

Y11-tests-grouped-with-it.note: Tests named for bounds written with describe/it; the check looked only at test(...).

Y12-bound-test-rewritten-same-meaning.note: Five notices for a test rewritten with the same values and assertions.

Y13-constructor-accepts-differently.note: An exported class is listed without its constructor's parameters.
